title: Auditor Assurance Pack: Hazira gas release and fire, 2020
audience: Internal audit, HSE audit teams, certification and regulatory inspectors, insurers
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document. Derived from a ProbeMatrix investigation export; learnings are evidence-linked but should be validated by the organisation before adoption.

data_quality.text: Draft learnings from an unreviewed analysis: the export's Investigation Status is in progress and no finding is marked as edited by a person.

bottom_line.text: Test returns to service first: pressure-boundary work went back into service tested only at operating pressure, with no procedure requiring more.
Test spares control: a seal with a lost specification was replaced by locally bought parts as normal practice, with no function owning the specification.
Test emergency isolation on paper and in the field: the plan gave no isolation criteria or delegated authority, and the valves could be closed only at the valve.
Test what detection does: fire and gas detection only lit an annunciator; it started no shutdown or suppression.
Test hazardous-area electrical inspection fitting by fitting: a damaged flameproof fitting stayed in service under breakdown-led maintenance.
Test the audits themselves: generic checklists recorded compliance without site data, and audit recommendations were extended without the required approval.

sections.heading: Why existing assurance did not catch it

items.text: Self-audits used a location checklist that was not specific to each plant and recorded compliance on most items, but the data behind the entries was incomplete; the internal audits gave observations without the filled checklists, so nobody could check what had been looked at.
Recommendations from the external safety audit were extended without the approval the procedure requires, so overdue safety actions had no governance step that forced a decision.

The records an audit would sample did not show the conditions: the malfunction notification for the meter was left open after the work and the signed calibration record did not show a setting change; the committee's report adds that electrical maintenance records listed only repaired items, not the inspection of the rest (OBS-27).
Drill records held no observations or actions, so drills could not reveal readiness gaps such as the missing isolation criteria.

sections.heading: Audit test points
sections.intro: Grouped by management-system element (no framework was chosen); clauses are given where the evidence touches a requirement in the standards crosswalk.

items.requirement: Pressure-boundary work is proved by a test to design pressure, under a written return-to-service procedure, before the equipment goes back into service.
items.sample: The last ten returns to service after work on a flange, seal or gasket in high-pressure hydrocarbon service.
items.conformity_evidence: For each job: the procedure in force, a test record stating the test pressure against the design pressure, and the signature of the person accepting the equipment back.
red_flags: Test recorded only as 'pressurised to operating pressure'
No return-to-service procedure for the equipment type
Test record dated after the equipment went back online

items.requirement: Maintenance that can cause a major release has an independent check of part, method and test before close-out.
items.sample: The same ten jobs, plus the planning record for each.
items.conformity_evidence: A named check role (by post) on the work order, a hold point for the check, and its signed result.
red_flags: Fitter is the only signature on the job
No inspection or test-witness role exists in the maintenance plan

items.requirement: Repeat failures on the same item are counted and trigger a reliability review.
items.sample: Work-order history for the meters and seals on the condensate metering skid and two other high-pressure skids.
items.conformity_evidence: A repeat-failure report or bad-actor list, and review minutes that name the item and the decision taken.
red_flags: Three or more repairs of the same kind on one item with no review
Each repair closed as routine with the same part

items.requirement: Explosion-protected equipment in hazardous areas is inspected item by item on schedule, and defects are recorded against each item.
items.sample: A walk-down of the flameproof fittings in one Zone 1 area, matched to the last two inspection records.
items.conformity_evidence: A register of fittings with unique identities, inspection records per fitting, and closed defects with dates.
red_flags: Inspection records that list only repaired items
Scheduled inspection skipped with no recorded reason
Fittings in the field with missing bolts or open enclosures

items.requirement: Calibration of safety-relevant instruments follows a checklist, and every setting change is recorded on the signed calibration record.
items.sample: The last two calibration records for each meter in the metering skids.
items.conformity_evidence: Checklists completed per job; as-found and as-left settings; the reason and approval for any change.
red_flags: Settings differ between consecutive records with no recorded change
No checklist for high-pressure meter work

items.requirement: Inspection results that show wall loss beyond limits lead to a corrective plan with an owner role and a decision record.
items.sample: Lines flagged with significant thickness loss in the last two inspection reports.
items.conformity_evidence: For each line: the assessment, the corrective option chosen and why, and evidence that it was done.
red_flags: Wall loss recorded with no corrective plan
Painting recorded as the fix for metal loss

items.requirement: The thickness inspection programme runs on its stated interval, with baseline data, and slippage is escalated.
items.sample: The inspection schedule against actual survey dates for the gas-terminal piping.
items.conformity_evidence: Survey dates, baseline readings per line, and escalation records for any late survey.
red_flags: Survey interval exceeded with no escalation
No baseline thickness for lines in service

items.requirement: Fire-water pumps are available as designed; trips are diagnosed and outages are limited and approved.
items.sample: Availability and test records for every diesel and electric fire-water pump over the last quarter.
items.conformity_evidence: Run-test records, trip diagnoses with actions, and approvals for each pump out of service.
red_flags: A pump that trips with no recorded diagnosis
More than one diesel pump out of service at a time with no approval

items.requirement: Changes of part, material or pipework, including like-for-unlike replacements, go through management of change.
items.sample: Changes made in the last year (purchase records for non-original spares, modification work orders).
items.conformity_evidence: A management-of-change record for each, with a risk review and an approval.
red_flags: No management-of-change record raised in a year with known changes
Non-original spares bought without a change record

items.requirement: Drawings used for maintenance and emergency response match the field and are approved.
items.sample: The P&IDs for the metering skids and two other high-pressure systems, checked in the field.
items.conformity_evidence: Approval status on each drawing, and a field check signed against the drawing.
red_flags: Vendor-made drawings with no approval
Valves or instruments on the drawing that are not in the field

items.requirement: Every pressure-boundary spare has a specification owned by a named function, and parts are checked against it before fitting.
items.sample: Stock and recent purchases of seals and gaskets for high-pressure service.
items.conformity_evidence: The specification for each part, the owning function, and receipt inspection or certificate records.
red_flags: Parts bought locally with no specification
No function owns re-establishing a lost specification

items.requirement: Hazardous work is done under a permit with a job safety plan, and missing permits are tracked.
items.sample: Permits for non-routine maintenance in the last month, against the maintenance notifications for the same work.
items.conformity_evidence: Serially filed permits, attached job safety plans, and a log of missing permits with follow-up.
red_flags: Work done against a notification with no permit
Permits missing from the file with no record of them

items.requirement: Control-room operators hold a defined qualification, including emergency practice, before being rostered.
items.sample: Training and qualification records for every control-room operator on the current roster.
items.conformity_evidence: The defined qualification, each operator's record against it, and emergency practice or simulator sessions.
red_flags: Operators rostered after general training only
No qualification defined in policy

items.requirement: The emergency plan states, for a major release, who may isolate, on what criteria, without waiting for escalation.
items.sample: The current emergency response and disaster management plan and the shift standing orders.
items.conformity_evidence: Isolation criteria, the delegated authority by post, and evidence the night shift has been briefed on them.
red_flags: The release scenario is named but no isolation decision is stated
Authority to isolate sits only with senior posts

items.requirement: Valves needed for emergency isolation can be operated from a place that stays reachable during a release.
items.sample: The isolation valves for each high-pressure inventory in the gas terminal.
items.conformity_evidence: For each valve: the operating location, remote operation where provided, and a function test record.
red_flags: Isolation valves operable only at the valve
No function test of remote operation

items.requirement: Fire and gas detection starts a defined protective action, not only an alarm.
items.sample: The fire and gas cause-and-effect chart for the gas terminal and the last function test.
items.conformity_evidence: The defined action for each confirmed detection, and test records showing the action works.
red_flags: Detectors wired to an annunciator only
No detector history in the control system

items.requirement: Drills are recorded with observations and actions, and the actions are tracked to closure.
items.sample: Drill records for the last year.
items.conformity_evidence: Observations, actions with an owner role, and closure records for each drill.
red_flags: Drill records with no observations or actions
Drill data kept outside the approved system

items.requirement: Maintenance notifications are closed with a record of the work and a close-out review before or at return to service.
items.sample: Notifications for work on high-pressure equipment closed or still open in the last quarter.
items.conformity_evidence: Close-out entries naming the work done and parts used, and the reviewer's sign-off.
red_flags: Notifications left open after the equipment returned to service
Closures with no record of the work done

items.requirement: Self-audits and internal audits use plant-specific checklists, and the completed checklists are kept with the evidence behind each compliance entry.
items.sample: The last self-audit and the last internal audit of the gas terminal.
items.conformity_evidence: Plant-specific checklists, completed and signed, with the data or observation behind each compliance entry.
red_flags: Generic checklists
Compliance recorded without site data
Completed checklists not kept

items.requirement: Extensions of due dates on audit recommendations are approved as the procedure requires, and each finding has a documented response.
items.sample: All open recommendations from the last external safety audit.
items.conformity_evidence: For each extension: the approval by the post the procedure names, and the documented response to the finding.
red_flags: Due dates extended with no approval document
Overdue actions with no owning function

rows: Pressure-boundary spares fitted without a specification (LR-01)
Purchase records for seals and gaskets; specifications on file; receipt inspection records
Maintenance planner and stores supervisor: how a part is chosen when the original is not available
Stores bins for high-pressure seals; one recently repaired flange
Return to service without a test to design pressure (LR-02)
Return-to-service records and test certificates for recent pressure-boundary work
Maintenance supervisor and shift operator who accepts equipment back: what test is normal and why
A recently repaired high-pressure joint and its test record
No isolation criteria or delegated authority in the emergency plan (LR-07)
The emergency plan, shift standing orders and the last drill record
Shift in-charge and control-room operator: who may isolate a major supply at night, and on what signal
The control room and the nearest isolation valve for a major inventory
Fire and gas detection that alarms but does not act (LR-10)
Cause-and-effect charts and the last detector function test
Control-room operator and instrument engineer: what happens after a detector alarms
The annunciator or control-system alarm display
Hazardous-area electrical defects left in service (LR-11)
Flameproof equipment register and the last two inspection records
Electrical maintenance supervisor: how a fitting is picked for inspection and how defects are recorded
Lighting and junction boxes in one Zone 1 area

items.text: Return-to-service records and pressure-test certificates for pressure-boundary work in high-pressure hydrocarbon service.
Work-order history and any repeat-failure report for the metering skids.
Specifications, purchase records and receipt inspection records for seals and gaskets.
Management-of-change register, and approval status of the P&IDs for the metering skids.
Calibration records and checklists for the metering-skid meters; fire and gas cause-and-effect charts and function tests.
Flameproof equipment register and inspection records for the Zone 1 areas.
Thickness survey reports, baseline data and corrective plans for gas-terminal piping.
Emergency response and disaster management plan, shift standing orders, drill records and control-room qualification records.
Open and closed maintenance notifications with close-out entries, and the permit file with job safety plans.
Self-audit and internal audit checklists, and the external audit action tracker with extension approvals.

Grade each test point on this scale: conforming; major nonconformity (NC); minor nonconformity; opportunity for improvement (OFI); not tested. Record the sample actually taken. Response to finding is for the audited organisation's documented response to each finding; leave it blank for them.

rows: tp-02 Independent check of critical repairs
tp-06 Corrective plans for wall loss
tp-12 Permits and job safety plans
tp-15 Isolation from a safe place

limits: The test points come from one event at one site, analysed from the enquiry committee's report; they test whether these conditions exist, not the whole management system.
No barrier or critical-control register was supplied, so the critical-control verification section is left out.
Clause ids are given only where the crosswalk holds a matching requirement; most test points are grouped by element instead.
